excluded_not_genuine_verb_usage.reason: gloss 'quickly' -- morph is HVpcc (infinitive construct) but functions adverbially in context, not as an action verb. Not added anywhere.

gloss 'cupbearer' -- morph is a near-even split of participial-verb and noun forms; functionally an occupational/role NOUN (a person), same category as H6001A/G1496 already corrected this session. Not added -- a T8 candidate, not T3, held for a future batch rather than guessed here.

gloss 'he is' -- morph V-PAI-3S, the copula 'to be'. Matches the precedent already set by heuristic-family-grouping-v1-20260905, which classified similar copula forms (G5600 'may be', G5607 'being') as T2, not a T-code. Not added.
gloss 'which is' -- relative+copula construction, same category as G2076. Not added.
gloss 'heat' -- mixed morph (verb infinitive + noun forms), functions as a noun ('heat of the day') in its actual usage. Not added.

gloss 'Lebo-[Hamath]' -- morph HVqcc (infinitive construct of the verb 'to come'), but functions as a place-name component (a boundary town) in every occurrence, not as an action verb. Not added -- a possible low-confidence T10 (Places) candidate, held rather than guessed here.
